items.title: 中国十一化建获得阿曼Duqm 890MW电站两项施工包
items.title_en: Chinese contractor wins two construction packages for Oman's 890MW Duqm power plant
items.summary: 中国十一化建获得Duqm 890MW联合循环燃气电站的两项施工包，涉及土建与现场支持。项目总体投资约9.1亿美元；报道发布于10月2日。
items.summary_en: China Eleventh Chemical Construction secured two construction packages covering civil works and site-support work at the 890MW Duqm combined-cycle gas power plant. The overall project investment is about US$910 million; the report was published on 2 October.
items.why_it_matters: 施工包已授予，但9.1亿美元是整体项目投资，不是中国十一化建的合同金额。
items.why_it_matters_en: Construction packages have been awarded, but US$910 million is the overall project investment, not the value of the Chinese contractor's packages.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注主项目和承包商后续分包及采购公告，尚未核实可公开投标的相关采购包。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor official procurement and subcontracting announcements; no specific open related package has been verified.

items.title: 阿曼Zaha Residence项目签署1000万里亚尔融资协议
items.title_en: Oman's Zaha Residence development signs OMR10 million financing agreement
items.summary: Al Ahly Sabbour公布Zaha Residence住宅项目，并与Bank Dhofar签署1000万阿曼里亚尔融资协议，以支持Wadi Zaha项目发展。公布时约350套住宅正在施工；报道日期为10月7日。
items.summary_en: Al Ahly Sabbour launched Zaha Residence and signed an OMR10 million financing agreement with Bank Dhofar to support the Wadi Zaha development. Around 350 residential units were under construction when announced on 7 October.
items.why_it_matters: 融资协议有利于在建住宅项目推进，不能直接视为新增建设合同授标。
items.why_it_matters_en: The financing supports an ongoing residential development; it is not itself a new construction contract award.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注已在建项目的后续工程、装修与建材需求及已公布采购安排。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track confirmed follow-on works, fit-out and building-material requirements and procurement notices.

items.title: Nakheel授予迪拜Bay Grove Residences逾8亿迪拉姆主施工合同
items.title_en: Nakheel awards over AED800 million main construction contract for Dubai's Bay Grove Residences
items.summary: Nakheel于9月17日宣布，向Metac General Contracting授出Dubai Islands Bay Grove Residences第1期及第3期主施工合同，合同金额超过8亿迪拉姆，涉及537套住宅，计划于2028年底主要完工。
items.summary_en: On 17 September, Nakheel announced a main construction contract worth over AED800 million to Metac General Contracting for phases 1 and 3 of Bay Grove Residences on Dubai Islands. The contract covers 537 homes, with main works targeted for completion in late 2028.
items.why_it_matters: 该项目已进入主合同授予阶段，但原始授标新闻并非10月新增。
items.why_it_matters_en: The main construction contract has been awarded, although the underlying announcement dates back to September.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注总包商后续分包及材料采购动向，并核对具体供应商准入要求。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor the main contractor's later subcontracting and materials purchases, subject to verified vendor requirements.

items.title: 突尼斯计划2027年新增约1600MW可再生能源装机
items.title_en: Tunisia plans around 1,600MW of new renewable capacity by 2027
items.summary: 突尼斯计划到2027年新增约1600MW可再生能源装机，其中约1100MW面向国际投资者的特许经营和许可项目，另约500MW拟用于自发自用。拟推进的项目包括Bazma 300MW光伏及储能。
items.summary_en: Tunisia plans to add around 1,600MW of renewable generation capacity by 2027, including approximately 1,100MW of concessions and licensing opportunities for international investors and about 500MW for self-generation. Planned developments include a 300MW solar-plus-storage project at Bazma.
items.why_it_matters: 这是国家发展计划与拟开放项目规模，并非所有项目已完成融资或授标。
items.why_it_matters_en: These are national development plans and prospective schemes, not evidence that every project has secured financing or contract awards.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注后续特许经营、许可及项目采购公告。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor future concessions, licensing rounds and project-level procurement notices.

items.title: 肯尼亚达成1.6亿美元Thamani Asili自然保护融资协议
items.title_en: Kenya secures US$160 million Thamani Asili conservation financing deal
items.summary: 肯尼亚通过Thamani Asili项目达成1.6亿美元自然保护融资安排，计划在十年期间支持约17.3万平方公里生态重要区域的保护。资金拟由政府与国际捐赠者共同承担。
items.summary_en: Kenya secured a US$160 million conservation financing arrangement through the Thamani Asili initiative. Over ten years, the programme aims to protect approximately 173,000 square kilometres of ecologically significant areas, funded jointly by the government and international donors.
items.why_it_matters: 融资服务于生态保护与长期管理，并非建筑工程合同或现成的招标项目。
items.why_it_matters_en: The financing supports conservation and long-term management; it is not an awarded construction contract or an immediately open tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 留意未来具体的生态修复、项目执行与服务采购公告。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Watch for specific restoration, implementation and services procurement announcements.

items.title: 西班牙Aena发布El Hierro机场路面与进场隧道工程招标
items.title_en: Spain's Aena tenders pavement and access-tunnel works at El Hierro Airport
items.summary: Aena于10月21日在欧盟招标平台发布El Hierro机场路面更新及进场隧道工程采购公告，估算价值约761万欧元（不含增值税），公告编号729507-2026。具体投标安排以原公告为准。
items.summary_en: On 21 October, Aena published an EU procurement notice for pavement rehabilitation and access tunnel works at El Hierro Airport. The estimated value is approximately EUR7.61 million excluding VAT, under notice 729507-2026. Tender conditions must be checked against the notice.
items.why_it_matters: 存在可识别采购机关、公告编号与预算的正式工程招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a formal works procurement with an identifiable buyer, notice number and estimated value.
items.gci_opportunity: 查阅TED原始招标文件、资质及截止安排；采购估算金额不等于合同授标价。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Review the original TED documents, eligibility and deadlines; estimated tender value is not an awarded contract price.
